title: On the wedding night or when buying an animal
arabic_title: دعاء المتزوج لنفسه ودعاء شراء الدابة

duas.occasion: When marrying a woman or purchasing a servant
duas.dua_english: When any of you marries a woman or purchases a maid-servant then let him say: O Allah, I ask You for the goodness of her, and the goodness upon which You have created her, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of her, and from the evil upon which You have created her. If you purchase a camel then take hold of the top of its hump and say the same.
duas.dua_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ
duas.dua_transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayrahā wa khayra mā jabaltahā 'alayh, wa a'ūdhu bika min sharrihā wa sharri mā jabaltahā 'alayh
